summary: Taking on the public workers: You send {the body} a bill that cuts what public workers can bargain for, and {union} fills the building.
realLife: One life: In 2011 the Wisconsin governor proposed sharp limits on public unions' bargaining, leaving out police and firefighters. Protesters filled the Capitol, all 14 Democratic senators went to Illinois to deny a quorum, and one Republican voted no. A recall followed. Another: In 2010 the New Jersey governor signed pension changes after promising police and firefighters none, and their unions sued. In 2011 he made a deal with Democratic leaders raising what workers paid and ending bargaining over health benefits.
